training.body: We'd like to use your anonymized consultation data to improve our AI for everyone. Your name, phone, and personal details are removed before any training use.
whatWeUseItems: The questions you ask and the AI's responses
Your age range, gender (no personal identifiers)
whatWeNeverUseItems: Your name, phone number, or email
